a.xlink:title: Leave SafeHold: full re-bring-up of both banks, which raises the enable pins again.
Turn every channel off, release both driver handlers and reset to uninitialised.
Ensure the valve manager system is initialized.
Disable every channel on every bank that is up (mutex held by the caller).
Check if a valve error code indicates success.
Drive MAX22200 ENABLE and TLE92466ED EN low: both banks de-energised in hardware.
Convert hf_valve_err_t to a human-readable description string.
Destroy both handlers and clear the bank flags (mutex held by the caller).
Map MAX22200 DriverStatus to the unified hf_valve_err_t domain.
Remember a failed operation result for GetLastError(); pass the result through.
Map TLE92466ED DriverError to the unified hf_valve_err_t domain.
Access the singleton instance (Meyers singleton, thread-safe).
Short name of a ManagerError, for logs and diagnostics.
